newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was fairly active late Thursday. Slaughter steers and heifers closed steady with late last week.

Inquiry was good, demand was fair. Sales confirmed on 29,000 slaughter steers and 21,000 slaughter heifers. For the week to date 68,000 head confirmed including 12,800 head or about 19 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Steers - select and choice 2-3 1065-1325 lbs 67.00; about 600 head 68.00; few select 66.00-67.00.
Heifers: select and choice 2-3 980-1175 lbs 67.00, pen 66.50.
week to date: 68000 last week: 87700 st year: 85400
